title: maat.json — configurazione di Maat per un progetto
description: Single source of the project's paths, commands and rules for the Maat harness (R2). Read only by scripts/maat-config.py, with an internal validator that covers the constructs used here: type (list too), required, enum, properties, items, additionalProperties: false, pattern. The defaults are the `default` keys of this file, plus radice_pacchetti = radice. Semantic checks, in the SEMANTICA table of maat-config.py: S1 regola_test specchio => specchio present; S2 comandi.test contains {test}, comandi.lint and every controlli[].comando contain {file}; S3 versione_schema accepted by the reader (current or previous, R9; greater = future version); S4 lint_base true => comandi.lint contains {base?...}; S5 a command of comandi that contains test-fast.sh => copia has the matching entry (test or lint); S6 no command of copia contains test-fast.sh; S7 copia.test contains {test}, every copia.lint and copia.lint_messaggi contains {file}; S8 regola_test nessuna => no comandi.test; S9 no generati[] entry is a golden, a snapshot or the lint baseline; S10 moduli[].preparati => preparazione present; S11 piano.taglia => harness >=1.7 or newer (1.7.0). Command placeholders: {file} and {test} (lists, each entry quoted separately), {base?prefix} and {cache?prefix} (optional: prefix, quoted value and a space, or nothing: `{base?--base }{file}` gives `--base 'b' 'f'` or `'f'`), {maat} (plugin root, always quoted), {python} (interpreter: FIC_GATES_VENV_PY > moduli[].python > piattaforma.python > python3 in the PATH), {report} (report file in the evidence), {nome} (name of a counterproof's test, quoted). Without a test command a module's gate is NOT RUN (dichiarato), never PASS.

$schema.description: Optional: reference to the schema, for editors.

versione_schema.description: Version of this schema used by the file. The reader accepts the current one (1) and the previous one with a warning (R9); a greater one gives «versione futura: aggiorna il plugin» (S3).

harness.description: Minimum plugin version required, in the form ">=MAJOR.MINOR".

lingua.description: Language of Maat's messages to the user: guard reasons, the explanation under each permission request (R11) and, from 1.4.0, the messages the scripts print (catalog scripts/lib/messages.tsv). The environment variable MAAT_LINGUA (it|en) wins over it. Default en.

cartelle.description: Where specs and run dirs live (lavoro) and the replay corpus (corpus).

lavoro.description: Work folder, relative to the repo.

corpus.description: Optional: the replay corpus.json, relative to the repo.

moduli.description: The project's modules. Each file of the repo belongs to the module with the longest radice that contains it (on equal length, the first in the list); outside every radice, to the one with the longest radice_pacchetti (it matters only for lint and build). The test rule of a file (test_di of R2) is the regola_test of its module.

nome.description: Module name: gives the gate labels (tests-<nome>, controlli-<nome>).

radice.description: Module folder, relative to the repo ("." = the whole repo).

radice_pacchetti.description: Packages folder (node_modules, workspace), relative to the repo. Default: radice.

regola_test.description: How the tests of a touched file are found: accanto (next to it), specchio (mirror, see specchio) or nessuna.

specchio.description: With regola_test specchio (S1): from a source file (da) to its tests (a), {m} = file name without extension. Relative to the radice.

ambiente.description: Where the module runs: wsl (WSL copy on Windows) or nativo.

python.description: The module's interpreter, relative to the radice (a name without / is looked up in the PATH). Precedence: FIC_GATES_VENV_PY > moduli[].python > piattaforma.python. A list = alternatives in order: the first that exists wins; if none exists -> the last path of the list. With ambiente wsl gates.sh looks for them INSIDE WSL (paths relative to the radice in /mnt/… form) and, if none exists, the gate that uses {python} is BLOCKED.

report.description: Format of the test report: junit (JUnit XML written to {report}: pytest --junitxml, which also runs unittest tests, or any runner whose failures carry the pytest file:line lines or a Python traceback), vitest (the output of vitest) or nessuno. The test-red phase of format-2 plans reads the outcome of each test from it: with nessuno the full cycle stops BLOCKED at test-red (maat-doctor: ATTENZIONE).

lint_base.description: true: the lint command accepts a base ({base?...}, S4) and the core classifies the errors as PREEXISTING/INTRODUCED/UNRESOLVED.

comandi.description: Commands the harness runs in the repo. Each is a string or {comando, cartella, se_presente?}. cartella (radice | radice_pacchetti | repo, default radice) is both the working directory and the base of the {file} and {test} paths. se_presente: an executable in the PATH, or a glob of files under the radice; if it is missing the command does not run and is NOT RUN (dichiarato).

lint.description: Lint command, with {file} (S2); the files are those under radice_pacchetti.

build.description: Build command, only for the full level.

copia.description: Commands that test-fast.sh runs INSIDE the WSL copy (never test-fast.sh itself, S6). cartella is relative to the copy. lint can be a list of alternatives: the first whose se_esiste (file relative to the cartella) exists, or that has no se_esiste, applies.

lint.description: With {file} (S7); a string, an object or a list of alternatives.

lint_messaggi.description: Prints the messages in eslint's compact format, for the lint with a base; with {file} (S7).

chiave.description: Extra entries of the evidence key: {etichetta, file} (fingerprint of the file, «assente» if missing) or {etichetta, comando} (the command's output); cartella as in the commands, default radice.

controlli.description: Checks that replace the tests (R2): glob relative to the radice, command with {file} (S2), se_presente = executable without which the entry is skipped and declared.

controprova.description: Runner of the module's counterproofs (counterproof.sh), run in the module's radice inside the copy. runner vitest or pytest: core adapters, which classify from the report ({report}: vitest JSON, pytest JUnit); comando: red = non-zero exit (rosso_generico, weak proof). comando with {test} (file relative to the radice; pytest: <file>::<nome>), {nome}, {report}, {python}. Without it (or without comando): every mutation is NOT RUN (dichiarato).

preparazione.description: Command that regenerates the generated files if they are missing (e.g. npx nuxi prepare).

preparati.description: Files prepared by the framework (ignored by git, written by the preparazione, S10): globs relative to the radice, e.g. the tsconfig and the declarations generated by the framework. The first glob without wildcards is the «file guida» (guide file). The folders that contain them are cleaned out of the copy (fic_mirror_pulisci): at every counterproof sync, and in test-fast.sh when the dependencies or the generated tsconfig change. ciclo-worktree.sh copies them from the main tree into the worktree if the guide file is there and missing in the worktree (otherwise it warns to run the preparazione), and checks the guide file in the WSL copy of a module with copia.

copia_anche.description: Read-only folders, relative to the repo, that the counterproofs copy together with the module (rsync -a --delete --checksum --exclude=node_modules), outside the manifest check: for example a schema read by the tests. The mutations stay under the module.

collega_nel_worktree.description: Folders of installed dependencies to link into a worktree (worktree-lib.sh: junctions on Windows, symlinks elsewhere; never copied nor installed): a string (relative to the radice) or {percorso, cartella}; percorso may contain *. Only those present in the main tree are linked. With no entries: no link.

separatori_test.description: 1.8.0 (D1-bis): the separators of the levels of the test names in the reports of this module (scripts/nomi_test.py), for an adapter that does not follow the language of the test file. Without it: by the extension of the test file (.go: /, .py: [, .rs: none, others: [), :: always.

file_dipendenze.description: Globs of the files that decide the dependencies (git :(glob) pathspec): a string (relative to the radice) or {glob, cartella}. If they differ between a worktree's base and the main tree, the linked dependencies are not valid: ciclo-worktree.sh and replay.sh stop.

gate.description: Commands run at each level. A command the module does not declare is skipped.

piattaforma.description: Platform: WSL copy (auto | sì | no), fallback Python interpreter, Node in WSL.

python.description: Last in the {python} precedence; relative to the repo, or a name in the PATH.

framework.description: Optional core adapters, active only if declared. nuxt-autoimport (blocks-independent.py): auto-imported components and composables, read from .nuxt/components.d.ts and .nuxt/imports.d.ts, and the aliases ~/ @/ ~~/ @@/, for modules with preparati under .nuxt/. Without adapters only explicit imports count.

guardia.description: The project's guard rules, in addition to the core (R3.6).

produzione.description: Case-insensitive regexes of production hosts, domains and paths: always severe.

rilascio.description: Release scripts, relative to the repo: always denied and severe, matched as a substring of the command (pk05); inside a script's content they count as a command.

involucri.description: Scripts that wrap remote access or the local copy: allowed and not read by the guard, except for the denied options (always severe, run directly or with bash). A string or {script, opzioni_negate}: the pk03 form, used as such since pk05.

vietati_extra.description: Extra command prefixes forbidden in the sub-sessions: they go into --disallowedTools (guard.py --deny-list) and the phase guard denies them.

suite.description: The project's suite scripts, with the pytest or vitest selection rules: in the plan, test-red and test-stage phases the guard denies them without files or selectors, like the core runners.

sonde.description: Literal hosts that match the production regexes: probes that test the guard (maat-config.py sonda-produzione).

verifica_remota.description: Optional: verification on a test environment. If absent, the cycle uses --no-dev.

contesto.description: For context-pack.sh: file and command of the DB schema, table recognition.

tabelle.description: blocco: regex with the name in group 1 and the body in group 2; nome_mappato: regex of the real name inside the block.

piano.description: Plan rules: critical surfaces and migration files, as regexes on the path relative to the repo.

taglia.description: 1.7.0: the size of the cycle (plan-check.sh taglia): piccola, a lighter flow, only if every fact of the plan is under its threshold; piena otherwise. Optional: without it every value below is its default. A file that uses it declares "harness": ">=1.7" or newer (S11).

automatica.description: Default true: the size is chosen by the script. false: always piena, unless the person gives --light.

soglie.description: The thresholds of piccola (each fact must be at most its value). Defaults: file_sorgente 3, file_nuovi 1, passi 6, requisiti 12, test 10, righe 250, simboli_pubblici 2.

parole_sicurezza.description: Security words ADDED to the built-in list (regexes, matched at word boundaries without case): any of them in the spec, the plan or the diff gives piena. The built-in words cannot be removed. Default: none added.

generati.description: Files GENERATED from the code that a test compares with the code: the implement and fix phases regenerate them with the entry's command, without it counting as a deviation from the plan, and declare them (`<percorso> (M) — rigenerato: <comando>`). percorso, cartella and test are relative to the repo; the command is run from the cartella, in the environment of the module that contains it (wsl: `wsl -- bash -lc 'cd <cartella> && <comando>'`), and names the script that regenerates (.py .mjs .js .sh, relative to the cartella). No field contains `|`. NOT generated files to regenerate (S9): goldens, __snapshots__ and the lint baseline, because regenerating them would absorb the regression they must catch. Reading and checking: maat-config.py generati [--verifica].

cartella.description: Folder to run the command from.

comando.description: Command that regenerates the file, run from the cartella.

test.description: The test that compares the file with the code (it names the file).

da_non_toccare.description: Globs of paths the cycle never changes.
